Sails in Sardinia takes us to the beautiful Italian island of Sardinia, the sescond largest island in the Mediterranean Sea, to visit the Yacht Club Costa Smeralda, in Porto Cervo. L'histoire de Lisa Beasley commence après qu'un très grave accident de Base Jump l'ait encouragée à revenir vers l'océan. Heureuse d'avoir survécu, elle doit maintenant faire face à une très longue période de convalescence qui la rapproche de sa mère ainsi que de son premier amour : l'océan. Les piscines de marée en particulier acquièrent une importance particulière dans la vie de Lisa, alors qu'elle prend conscience du fragile écosystème qui les a colonisées. Elle entreprend ainsi de changer les techniques de nettoyages qui détruisent cette vie marine si fragile.

The Nautic Paris International Boat Show is the largest indoor port in France and one of the most important boat shows of its kind in the world. Every year it gathers all sectors of the nautical industry, with over 150,000 qualified visitors, 95,000 m2 of exhibitions in 9 days of amusement, new technology and products to the delight of nautical enthusiasts. Follow the highlights of the Nautic Paris International Boat Show and discover the latest trends in sailing and motor boats, water sports, nautical equipment, new technologies, boat rental services, tourism and fishing at the Porte de Versailles.

Hello from Sweden! We are on our way to the island of Orust. This island lives from boatbuilding, and big companies produce sailing boats here to expand their boats to the entire world. When the economic crisis stroke, demand decreased, thus less boats were ordered. This forced habitants of the small island of Orust to find a new path. Refit has become the new trend in Second Life in Scandinavia. Giving a new life to beautiful yachts, not only the economy is changing, but the local community as well. Lucia will venture into the island of Orust to learn more about the way its population has adapted and how it has become the mecca of boatbuilding. Watch out now, on Nautical Channel.

programmes.t: The Cyclades with Andi van Zyl
programmes.d: Join our host, South African born Andi van Zyl, as she travels to the Cyclades group of Greek islands in the Aegean Sea. Located to the south-east of the mainland, the islands enjoy year-round sunshine and are home to some of Greece's most important archaelogical sites such as the bithplace of Apollo and the tomb of Homer. L'histoire de Lisa Beasley commence après qu'un très grave accident de Base Jump l'ait encouragée à revenir vers l'océan. Heureuse d'avoir survécu, elle doit maintenant faire face à une très longue période de convalescence qui la rapproche de sa mère ainsi que de son premier amour : l'océan. "We're just two surfers that decided we could no longer ignore plastic pollution in our oceans." -Luise Grossmann. Two young innovators created the first sustainable surfboard fin based on ocean-recycled plastics. The founders of FiveOceans give ocean rubbish a new life, using plastic collected from the Indian Ocean, proving it is possible to close the cycle with ocean waste and high quality surf gear. In this stunning documentary, they prove their mission and reveal a transparent value chain of the waste material to design a performance product for surfers. With their background in engineering, the unrivalled story is underlined by surfing, adventure and great personalities as the two friends battle their way to achieve a much higher goal: reducing the plastic that ends up in the oceans they surf.

What The Sea Gives Me is a feature length documentary comprised of intimate & candid interviews with some of the ocean's most extraordinary ambassadors including Great White shark researcher Brett McBride, artist Matt Beard, photographer Chris Burkard, bodysurfer Angie Oschmann, conservationist Jean-Michelle Cousteau, free-diver Herbert Nitsch. We give you an honest and personal look through the eyes of those who thrive under the most extreme water conditions, those ensuring the proper care of the oceans for future generations and those who simply derive a sense of pure joy from the sea.
